notes: Major code SE31 (SHM/NDE). Same core as SE27; the SHM/NDE focus sequence appears on the diploma. Per the general catalog the capstone is SE 165 taken together with one additional technical elective, rather than a two-course design sequence. Minimum 145 units plus college GE.

buckets.label: Introductory Structural Engineering
buckets.note: SE 1, SE 3, SE 9 all confirmed on both catalog and department pages.

buckets.label: Capstone
buckets.note: SHM/NDE uses SE 165 as its single capstone design course; the catalog specifies it is taken together with one additional technical elective.

buckets.label: Technical electives
buckets.note: 3 preapproved technical electives outside the focus sequence; SE 195/197/198 not allowed. Note: SHM/NDE takes one extra TE alongside the SE 165 capstone per catalog.

buckets.label: General education
buckets.note: Minimum 24 units plus college GE. Engineering major bucket pointing to the college's own General Education program (note: 'Minimum 24 units plus college GE'). At UCSD, GE course sets are defined per-college (Revelle, Muir, Marshall, Warren, ERC, Sixth, Seventh), not by the SE department, so this is satisfied through the student's college GE section rather than a fixed SE course list.

buckets.label: Total program units
buckets.note: Minimum 145 units. Pure minimum unit total for the major: 145 units minimum. No course list; satisfied by accumulating the required units across major + GE coursework.
